title: Excited to see the box in my mailbox but......
text: I was disappointed with the box. Two of the products were for frizzy hair, mine is totally straight. The package had two self -tanning wipes, I am not sure how much area they would cover and don't want to risk having a spotty tan on just part of my body. The green eye liner is nice but not a color I would wear. The eye shadow and brush we're both very nice. I am sure I will wear the eye shadow but will probably give the rest away.
label: neutral
